outcome: duration of active phase of labor
cohort: The study included 201 pregnant women undergoing labor induction with Dinoprostone, consisting of 137 cases achieving vaginal delivery and 64 cases resulting in cesarean delivery.
finding: Periodical cervical length measurements, cervical effacement, cervical dilatation, and Bishop score at the initiation and during labor induction were significantly correlated with the outcome and duration of labor.
mod_finding: Cervical shortening from the beginning to the 4th hour, 4th to 8th hour, and beginning to 8th hour of induction was significantly higher in the vaginal delivery group compared to the cesarean delivery group.
